text:
There is a bunch of bugs here actually. In js_NativeSet we never trigger the method write barrier if a property is added (added=true), because we think that can't cause a shape change, but that's not true for watchpoint setters which fire for additions as well since they are persistent. So in other words watch makes our write barrier more expensive in general. Super lame.
There is a second bug. The slot is initialized to undefined when we call the setter, so even if we would call the method write barrier it would see undefined (old) == undefined (new) and not brand.
I think this is all pretty seriously broken and all sorts of unsafe. I vote for a hard blocker. This probably wants jorendorff or brendan, though I think I can fix it if push comes to shove.

I think the FM radio should immediately shut itself off when you unplug the headset (which functions as the antenna).  Playing static through the phone's external speaker when the headset is disconnected is not useful in any way.

Criteria for Classification:

Instructions:
Classify the following issue report comment as either “Solution-related (1)” or “Non-solution-related (0)” and provide the response by strictly using the Response Format (i.e., either 1 or 0). You must not include anything else in the response. In the given comment, the text portion with source code, stack trace, and webpage links are replaced with the masks –source_code–, –stack_trace–, and –webpage_link– respectively.

1 or 0

Criteria for Classification:
“Solution-related”: The comment is written by a person and describes any of these three information kinds:
1. a description of the solution to the reported problem in the issue report, proposed by a developer;
2. an assessment of the feasibility of a proposed solution made by another developer; or
3. a description of the implemented solution for solving the issue made by a developer.

“Non-solution-related”: Any other comments that do not describe the above three kinds of information. The comment that does not contain any human-written text, i.e., contains only auto-generated text (e.g., only links, bot messages, only attachments, etc.), should be considered as “Non-solution-related”. If a developer performs a code review, i.e., checks for problems in the patch/code of the implemented solution, then it should be considered as “Non-solution-related”. 

Instructions:
Classify the following issue report comment as either “Solution-related (1)” or “Non-solution-related (0)” and provide the response by strictly using the Response Format (i.e., either 1 or 0). You must not include anything else in the response. In the given comment, the text portion with source code, stack trace, and webpage links are replaced with the masks –source_code–, –stack_trace–, and –webpage_link– respectively.
Response Format:
1 or 0

"""–webpage_link–"""

Optimized DoubleToECMAInt32 for ARM.
